<view 
  id="{{api.rootProps.id}}"
  class="{{rootClass}}" 
  role="progressbar" 
  aria-valuemin="{{api.min}}"
  aria-valuenow="{{api.value}}" 
  aria-valuemax="{{api.max}}"
  data-state="{{api.state}}"
>
  <view 
    class="{{indicatorClass}}" 
    style="transform: translateX(-{{100 - api.percent}}%)"
  ></view>
</view>
